HttpPromise.luau.description: Provides a wrapper around HttpService with a promise API By combining functions in HttpPromise, we can get a generic request result in a very clean way. Public entry points include `logToDiscord`, `HttpPromise.request`, `HttpPromise.isHttpResponse`, `HttpPromise.convertHttpResponseToString`, `HttpPromise.json`, `HttpPromise.logFailedRequests`, `HttpPromise.decodeJson`.
